adversarial_or_fault_proof: Reject any surviving QM Postgres/keychain/plugin truth or authority owner, any host-database dependence, any non-fail-closed unavailable-owner state, and any second sequencing owner.
compatibility_and_migration: The dormant adoption is the read-old input; the rebind is write-new against canonical owners; no compatibility layer becomes a second truth owner.
